findings.text: 此智能体安装自应用内置的智能体。
findings.note: Tautological 'agent ... from ... agent' and 应用内置的智能体 can be misread as the current agent, blurring it against shipped_with_app. Suggest 此智能体安装自应用内置版本。 (reuses 内置版本 from origin.changed and install_builtin); fallback 此智能体由应用内置的智能体安装而来。 Wording is accurate and consistent with ui.agents.starters.* (内置智能体), so not a major.

内置指令 can be misread as 'built-in commands' rather than the original built-in instructions. Suggest 与内置版本的指令对比. 指令 itself matches section.instructions and 内置 matches origin.changed; acceptable as is if length matters.

findings.note: Consistency record only, no change required: 安装自 aligns with install.action.install_to_edit (安装可编辑副本); adopting A-1 would also align with install_builtin (改为安装内置版本).

starter_term_decision.defensible: Yes. It matches the existing catalogue and the sidecar instruction to stay consistent with the starters catalogue; a new 模板/入门 term would contradict it.
